environment: Normal main-camera Development Player frames; process/device identity does not establish physical multi-machine validation.
acceptanceScope: First playable release: full workloads and frame percentiles; rare full-frame spikes and extreme support-clear latency remain recorded risks. This is not strict stable-60 acceptance.

gates.name: acceptanceProfile
gates.detail: The named profile must be recognized; prototype-v1 is distinct from strict and short-duration diagnostics.

gates.name: completeDuration
gates.detail: Short CLI durations produce diagnostics only.

gates.name: developmentPlayer
gates.detail: Editor frames are not Player performance evidence.

gates.name: normal1080pMainCamera
gates.detail: Every sampled normal backbuffer frame must have one actual main-camera render; no substitute camera or render texture.

gates.name: gpuTiming
gates.detail: Unique positive finite GPU timings must cover at least 80% of sampled frames; missing data is unverified.

gates.name: mainAndRenderTiming
gates.detail: Each thread must have positive finite timings in at least 80% of sampled frames.

gates.name: no33msSpikes
gates.detail: Every spike is retained in this conservative full-frame record; prototype-v1 reports the risk without declaring strict acceptance.

gates.name: terrainTransactions
gates.detail: Errors or failed transactions invalidate a run.

gates.name: workload
gates.detail: Surviving blocks include falling blocks; no reduced fixture count.

gates.name: eightContinuousShooters
gates.detail: All eight actual ShotSequence values must keep advancing; a two-second gap makes a sampled interval inactive.

gates.name: ordinaryPublishLatency
gates.detail: Actual primary main-attack building and direct enemy-removal contacts only; excludes trails, probes, blasts, sub weapons and specials.

pendingPhaseWallSemantics: disjoint observation boundaries: generation prefix includes early Upload/Bake; upload and Bake fields are the remaining observed tails, not complete activity
pendingWorkerCriticalInnerIntervalSemant: legacy InnerTaskDispatch name; interval is semaphore-acquired to BuildBodyStart; no inner Task.Run is scheduled by this pipeline
pendingWorkerMeshSplitSemantics: Rendered pieces: RenderBuild includes shared exposure scan and render emission/output; CollisionBuild begins at renderReady and includes scratch clear, collision emission/output and scratch return. Collision-only pieces use legacy Build, including its scan. These are elapsed wall regions, not CPU time; individual regions across versions do not represent equal work.
pendingPipelineOverlaySemantics: piece elapsed sums and first-to-last overlap windows; may contain gaps/concurrency; not CPU time and not additive to phase wall or each other
